name: Noir Ink Kinetic
description: Ink that behaves like ink: a sumi brush that loads, splays and runs dry, a dry comb that cross-hatches on the return pass, splatter thrown as far as you fling it, a wash that stays wet and dries to a ring, and a nib that pools where you rest and catches on the upstroke.
author: HereLiesAz

manifest.name: Noir Ink Kinetic
manifest.description: Ink that behaves like ink: a sumi brush that loads, splays and runs dry, a dry comb that cross-hatches on the return pass, splatter thrown as far as you fling it, a wash that stays wet and dries to a ring, and a nib that pools where you rest and catches on the upstroke.
manifest.author: HereLiesAz

step: // Wet Sumi: a comb of hairs. It loads at touchdown (longer dwell, more ink), spends ink with
// every px laid, and the outer hairs run dry first. Pressure splays the hairs; a slow brush
// lays ink into the wet ledger and crossing still-wet ink bleeds.
if (index == 0) { load = clamp(0.8 + dwell / 2000, 0.8, 1.0); splay = pr; }
let ahead = wetAt(px + cos(heading) * diameter * 0.8, py + sin(heading) * diameter * 0.8, diameter * 0.4);
let dry = smoothstep(0.75 * (1 - load), 0.75 * (1 - load) + 0.25, streak + 0.25 * ink);
emit { x: px + cx * off, y: py + cy * off, size: diameter * (0.2 + 0.12 * h) * (0.7 + 0.5 * splay), alpha: a, angle: heading, tip: 1 };
emit { x: px, y: py, size: w * (1.3 + 0.6 * bleed), alpha: 0.12 * bleed * load, angle: heading, tip: 0.8 };
emit { x: px, y: py, size: w * 1.05, alpha: 0.35 * load * (slow - 0.6), angle: heading, tip: 0.7 };
// Dry Hatch: a dry comb that lays parallel slivers at the hand's habitual 45 degrees,
// one every third of a diameter. Turn back over your own line and the hatch flips to the
// opposite diagonal, so a return pass cross-hatches. Speed skips the comb on the tooth.
emit { x: px + jx + ca * t * L, y: py + sa * t * L, size: L * 0.42, alpha: min(1, a * 1.3), angle: ang, tip: 1 };
// Flung Splatter: drops thrown off the brush by the hand. Slow, they fall beside the line;
// at speed they fly ahead, farther and more of them, stretched along their flight. A sharp
// turn flings a burst out along the old direction.
let n = (0.5 + v * 1.6) * (0.5 + pr) * stepPx / max(diameter, 1) * 2.2;
let k = floor(n) + gate(1 - fract(n), rand());
let el = clamp(1 - v * 0.18 * (1 - big) * thr / max(diameter, 1), 0.3, 1);
emit { x: px + cos(heading) * thr - sin(heading) * side, y: py + sin(heading) * thr + cos(heading) * side, size: sz / sqrt(el), tip: el, angle: heading, alpha: 1 };
let m = min(16, floor(4 + v * 3 + tn * 0.05));
let el = clamp(1 - 0.12 * v * far / max(diameter, 1), 0.25, 1);
emit { x: px + cos(fa) * far, y: py + sin(fa) * far, size: sz / sqrt(el), tip: el, angle: fa, alpha: 1 };
// Ring Wash: a dilute wash that stays wet (the ledger). Its body barely builds; where it runs
// over wash that is still wet it darkens, and its pigment migrates to the edge of the wet
// patch, drying to a tide line. Hold still and the pool spreads and settles darker.
if (index == 0) { sx = px; sy = py; grow = 0; started = 0; }
let prior = (phase == 1 ? wetAt(px + cos(heading) * r * 1.4, py + sin(heading) * r * 1.4, r * 0.5) : 0);
emit { x: px, y: py, size: 2 * r, alpha: 0.02 + 0.03 * pr, angle: hash(index) * 360, tip: 1 };
emit { x: px, y: py, size: 2 * r, alpha: (0.012 + 0.014 * pr) * (1 + 2.5 * wetness), angle: hash(index * 1.3) * 360, tip: 1 };
// tide line along both edges, only where the paper just outside is dry
let ex = px + cos(hd) * r * 0.86 * sg;
let ey = py + sin(hd) * r * 0.86 * sg;
let out = wetAt(px + cos(hd) * (r + 8) * sg, py + sin(hd) * (r + 8) * sg, 4);
emit { x: ex, y: ey, size: diameter * 0.3, alpha: (0.11 + 0.07 * pr) * edge, tip: 1 };
emit { x: sx + cos(a) * r * 0.86, y: sy + sin(a) * r * 0.86, size: diameter * 0.3, alpha: 0.07 + 0.04 * pr, tip: 1 };
emit { x: px + cos(a) * r * 0.86, y: py + sin(a) * r * 0.86, size: diameter * 0.3 * (1 + 0.3 * grow), alpha: 0.07 + 0.05 * grow, tip: 1 };
// Blotting Nib: a steel nib. Ink keeps flowing while it rests, pooling in the wet ledger into
// a blot that grows with the dwell; speed thins the line. Pushing the nib upstroke makes it
// catch on the paper: the line skips, then spits a fan of spatter and a small blot.
emit { x: px, y: py + bs * 0.04, size: bs, alpha: 1, angle: 0, tip: 1 };
emit { x: px, y: py, size: bs * 1.25, alpha: 0.12, angle: 0, tip: 1 };
grab = grab - stepPx / max(diameter, 1) * push * (0.08 + 0.12 * pr);
emit { x: px + cos(a) * far, y: py + sin(a) * far, size: diameter * (0.15 + 0.35 * pow(rand(), 2)), alpha: 1, angle: a, tip: 0.8 };
emit { x: px, y: py, size: diameter * 1.7, alpha: 1, angle: 0, tip: 1 };
emit { x: px, y: py, size: diameter * 1.3, alpha: 1, angle: 0, tip: 1 };

description: The print room, misbehaving as it should: a canvas-locked halftone whose dots swell with pressure and shrink with haste, riso drums that drift out of register and starve, a squeegee that floods where you dawdle and leaves a ridge where you lift, a stipple pen that only counts time, and a gouge that chips and skips.

manifest.name: Print Shop Kinetic
manifest.description: The print room, misbehaving as it should: a canvas-locked halftone whose dots swell with pressure and shrink with haste, riso drums that drift out of register and starve, a squeegee that floods where you dawdle and leaves a ridge where you lift, a stipple pen that only counts time, and a gouge that chips and skips.

step: // a 45-degree screen locked to the canvas; ink becomes dot area, never a soft edge
let cu = floor((px + py) * s / pitch);
let cv = floor((py - px) * s / pitch);

// a squeegee: the blade lays what the mesh lets through. Slow floods, fast starves into streaks,
// what is left on the blade is dumped as a ridge where it lifts.
let cov = clamp(flood * firm * 1.35 - (1 - st) * (1 - flood) * 1.9 + wet * 0.002, 0, 1);
emit { x: px + nx * t * W * 0.5, y: py + ny * t * W * 0.5, size: lw * 10, alpha: cov * 0.8, angle: heading, tip: 0.2 };
// held: ink keeps coming through the mesh and pools along the blade, then squeezes out of its ends
emit { x: px + nx * t * W * 0.5, y: py + ny * t * W * 0.5, size: lw * 3.2, alpha: 0.25, angle: heading, tip: 0.55 };

emit { x: px + nx * sd * W * (0.5 + 0.12 * sq) + hx * W * 0.05 * rands(), y: py + ny * sd * W * (0.5 + 0.12 * sq) + hy * W * 0.05 * rands(), size: W * (0.12 + 0.2 * sq), alpha: 0.9, tip: 1, angle: rand() * 360 };
